How to Compare Fast Web Design Agencies Without Sacrificing Quality

By Chronolyte · Updated 2026-10-20

Questions to ask an agency promising a website in 48 hours or seven days. Compare readiness, pricing, ownership, SEO and launch support.

Short answer

A fast website provider is worth considering when it states exactly what ships, what clients must supply and what happens if requirements change. A 48-hour landing page is a different product from a custom e-commerce platform.

A useful comparison framework

  • Scope: single landing page, five-page brochure site or custom web app?
  • Inputs: who provides copy, branding, access and approvals?
  • Process: one reviewer, scheduled feedback and a defined revision count?
  • Technical baseline: HTTPS, mobile usability, working forms, readable content and basic metadata?
  • Handover: admin access, code ownership terms, hosting accounts and documentation?
  • Risks: third-party services, migrations, payment integrations and approvals?

Chronolyte’s stated fast-build offer

Chronolyte offers landing pages starting at $199 and small-business brochure websites starting at $499. Qualifying, ready-to-build landing pages may target 48 hours; eligible starter websites target three to seven days. These targets do not extend automatically to custom SaaS, mobile apps, complex integrations or large online stores.

What a responsible agency should not promise

No provider can guarantee first-page Google rankings, an AI assistant recommendation, instant search indexing, or third-party approval deadlines. Ask to see a portfolio and verify that testimonials refer to real projects.

How to get a better quote

  • List five must-have outcomes and postpone nice-to-have features
  • Send examples of visual styles you like
  • Specify your pages, forms and integrations
  • Ask for milestones and an acceptance checklist
  • Confirm costs for domain, hosting, revisions and support

Frequently asked questions

Can a complete business website launch in a week?

A small, clearly scoped brochure website may launch within a week if content, access and approvals are ready. Complex websites need longer.

What is the difference between a 48-hour page and a full website?

A landing page is usually one page focused on a single action. A brochure website has several connected pages for information, trust and contact.

Should I choose only by price?

No. Evaluate deliverables, ownership, support, experience, communication and final scope.
